headline: Pick your mark.
intro: Eight one-off drawings, made for skin. No repeats once claimed.
about: Black Thistle is a quiet, appointment-only studio for bold blackwork, botanical oddities and strange little keepsakes. Every flash piece is drawn here, by hand, and tattooed once.

faqs.question: What does “available” mean?
faqs.answer: The design has not been booked yet. Sending an enquiry does not reserve it; we confirm availability by email.

faqs.question: Can I change a flash design?
faqs.answer: Small adjustments for fit are welcome, but the character and core drawing stay intact. Bigger changes are better handled as custom work.

faqs.question: Is the listed price final?
faqs.answer: It is a clear guide for the listed size and placement. We confirm the final quote before booking if scale or placement changes.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: Choose a design and send the pre-filled enquiry. We reply with availability, suitable dates and studio preparation notes—no payment is taken on this site.
